page.title: Overview
page.description: What is on your menu right now, and what is still missing.

checklist.title: Finish your menu
checklist.complete: Everything guests look for is on your menu.
checklist.incomplete: Each of these makes your menu more useful to guests.

logo.label: Your logo
logo.hint: It sits at the top of your menu.

cover.label: A cover photo
cover.hint: The first thing guests see when the menu opens.

description.label: A short description
description.hint: One line under your name on the menu.

hours.label: Opening hours
hours.hint: Guests see whether you are open right now.

location.label: Your location
location.hint: Guests get a map and directions.

phone.label: A phone number
phone.hint: Guests can call you, chat on WhatsApp, and send orders.

categories.label: A category
categories.hint: Categories are the tabs guests move between.

dishes.label: A dish
dishes.hint: Nothing shows on your menu until it has dishes.

photos.label: Dish photos
photos.hint: A photo shows guests what they are ordering.

social.label: A social link
social.hint: Guests can follow you from the menu.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: How guests find your menu and what they do on it.

visits.title: Visits
visits.description: Each time your menu was opened.
visits.empty: No visits in this range yet. Share your menu link, or put the QR code on your tables.
visits.chartLabel_one: {{views}} views over {{count}} day, {{scans}} of them QR scans.
visits.chartLabel_other: {{views}} views over {{count}} days, {{scans}} of them QR scans.

arrive.title: How guests arrive
arrive.empty: No visits in this range yet.

busiest.title: Busiest times
busiest.description: When guests open your menu, in your restaurant's time.

actions.title: What guests do
actions.description: Taps and searches on your menu. What happens after a tap, like the call itself, happens outside it and is not counted.

topAdded.title: Most added to the cart
topAdded.empty: Nothing added to a cart in this range.

topCategories.title: Most opened categories
topCategories.empty: No category picked in this range.

missed.title: Searched but not found
missed.description: Guests looked for these and your menu had nothing to show.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: The language guests read your menu in.

locked.title: Advanced analytics
locked.description: Comes with the bigger packages. Your menu already records all of this, so it is there the day you move up.
